_README: Agent-hours and cash per channel per week, for `npm run review`.
Hand-kept, because nothing in the system records an agent-hour and the
effort-allocation check (TOG-92 step 5, roadmap-30d §9) is the half of the
review that catches a month spent on listings because listings are easy.
Copy this to data/growth-effort.json and edit it every Friday. An ABSENT
field is not zero: a channel with no agentHours recorded is reported as
unmeasured and can never be killed, because the kill rule needs sustained
effort AND 0 AM30, and dropping the first half lets neglect masquerade as a
negative result. Write 0 when a channel genuinely got no time - that is a
measurement and it is allowed to count.
channelId  a slot from REGISTERED_CHANNELS in src/growth/portfolio.ts.
weekStart  the UTC Monday, YYYY-MM-DD.
cashPence  pence, not pounds. £0 is the registered plan while EXP-008 is locked.
The per-experiment fields below are the facts the funnel cannot carry. The
most recent recorded value of each is what the rules read.
bumpsExpected/bumpsDone   listings. Under 50% compliance INVALIDATES the
week rather than counting against the channel
(EXP-001) - it measures our bump discipline.
outputProduced            EXP-005. Were clips actually made and posted?
Checked at 4 weeks; AM30 waits until 8.
referralLinkCreators      EXP-003. How many of the 5 asked members made a
link. Referral is killed on the ask, never on AM30.
partnerNights             EXP-004. Nights with the CURRENT partner.
partnersWithZeroAm30      EXP-004. Partners exhausted so far. The channel
dies only after three have each produced 0 AM30.
weeksLive                 EXP-005. Weeks since the channel started.
